rcsr-07-c3.quote: why would God design human minds and environments such that so many competing religious traditions naturally arise and compete in the first place?
rcsr-07-c3.claim: if God cares about the details of belief, why design minds and environments in which so many competing traditions naturally arise?

rcsr-07-c3.text: Jason Marsh (2026). Evolutionary Approaches to Religion. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
rcsr-07-c3.quote: Many theistic scientists, including Justin Barrett, not only seek to incorporate CSR’s findings into their religious worldview; they further contribute to the theoretical and empirical literature (J. Barrett 2004).
rcsr-07-c3.claim: Justin Barrett, a theist, is a prominent contributor who builds the field's findings into his faith
